## File: NousResearch_hermes-agent/skills/productivity/maps/scripts/maps_client.py

Prompts

```
['geocode a place name to coordinates using the maps_client search command', 'reverse geocode latitude and longitude coordinates to a human-readable address', 'find nearby points of interest by category around a given location or address', 'calculate road distance and travel time between two places for a given travel mode', 'get step-by-step turn-by-turn directions between two places with formatted instructions']
```

Usage

```
{'geocode_place_name': 'geocode a place name to coordinates using the maps_client search command', 'reverse_geocode_coordinates': 'reverse geocode latitude and longitude coordinates to a human-readable address', 'find_nearby_pois': 'find nearby points of interest by category around a given location or address', 'calculate_road_distance': 'calculate road distance and travel time between two places for a given travel mode', 'get_turn_by_turn_directions': 'get step-by-step turn-by-turn directions between two places with formatted instructions'}
```
